description: Six actual searches (four weekly windows, one Belarusian-language sector/regional query, one adjacent-month episode query) surfaced 120+ result headers, and four in-month exact pages were opened. The bounded pass emphasizes Sunday courtyard activity; women, workers, student/pensioner actions, earlier weekdays and regional cities lack independent exact-date follow-up. A BelNovosti result surfaced by Q005 proved to be Oct26 and was excluded as out of month. No claim of exhaustive daily coverage is made.
required_followup: Prioritize date-specific women, worker, student, pensioner and regional searches only where they can establish an exact domestic gathering, threshold, demand or state response. Do not treat fixed query count as quota or coverage proof.
